description: A minimal, CPU-only build of ONNX Runtime 1.28.0 for Android, built and published by Sleep Cycle for the Sleep Cycle SDK. It is not an official Microsoft release. Being a minimal build it reads only the .ort model format and cannot load .onnx, and its operator kernels are reduced to a fixed set, so it loads only models whose operators that set covers. Built for armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a.
